g.text: Mean hybrid prediction over the held-out interval
Combined respiratory visits (% of all ED visits)
Alaska and Hawaii are shown as repositioned insets; grey is missing, not zero.
State color averages all included reporting records within each state; no population weighting.
County labels may share HSA-level values. State aggregates are included; the U.S. aggregate is not mapped.
NSSP uses a separate 0-4% scale and a different target from the two ILINet maps.
